Description: IÉ requires the services of a suitably qualified organisation to work closely with the Infrastructure Human Resources Manager and Railway Undertaking Human Resources Manager in the support and delivery of selection and recruitment processes that will contribute to the objective of maintaining a robust framework for the recruitment of safe, efficient and competent personnel. Additional services may include the provision of professional advice, expert guidance and training relating to the areas covered by the services.
